{{Quote|Looks like he's already staking a claim.|Qui-Gon Jinn, upon seeing Attichitcuk's camp|audio=AttichitcuksCamp.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
'''Attichitcuk's camp''' was a settlement built by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] at some point between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]], during his [[Alaris Prime colonists|group's]] [[Alaris Prime colonial war|colonization attempt]] of the moon. The camp was built in a small [[Tree/Legends|forest]] clearing and only had four buildings. After Attichitcuk built the camp, it was found by his son, [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and his friend [[Shoran]] with the help of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]. At the same [[Time/Legends|time]], four [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]], predators on Alaris Prime, attempted to [[Attack on Attichitcuk's camp|destroy]] the camp, but the three Wookiees were able to defend it.

==Description==
A camp was built by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]] on [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], a [[Tree/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] that a [[Alaris Prime colonists|group]] of Wookiees were trying to colonize. The camp was built in a small clearing in the forest, but [[marker]]s were placed so any travelers could find a path to the camp. The camp consisted of four buildings: one [[command center]], the main building in the camp; and three [[prefab shelter]]s, which could house Wookiees living in the compound.<ref name="GB" />

==History==
{{Quote|Chewbacca's father, Attichitcuk, awaits us to the north. I can see one of his markers ahead.|Qui-Gon Jinn, to Chewbacca and Shoran|audio=HeSeesYou.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Tutorial_1_gundarks_attack.png|thumb|right|250px|Attichitcuk, Chewbacca, and Shoran defend the camp from gundarks.]]
Attichitcuk built his camp at some point between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]]<ref name="NEC" /> as part of the Wookiee [[Alaris Prime colonial war|colonization]] effort on Alaris Prime. The camp was one of the first settlements on Alaris Prime and was built shortly after Attichitcuk arrived on the moon. Attichitcuk stayed at the camp until his son, [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and his friend [[Shoran]] arrived there with assistance from [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], who had been sent by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] to oversee the colonization effort. At the same [[Time/Legends|time]] as their arrival, the camp was [[Attack on Attichitcuk's camp|attacked]] by four [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]], the main predatory threat on Alaris Prime. The three Wookiees quickly fought off and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the gundarks in order to stop them from destroying the camp. Attichitcuk, Chewbacca, and Shoran continued to lead a successful colonization effort on Alaris Prime.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Click a warrior and right click a gundark to attack. Defeat them before they tear down the camp!|Qui-Gon Jinn, to the player, when gundarks attack the camp|audio=ClickAWarrior.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
Attichitcuk's camp was first mentioned in [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]] by [[Steven L. Kent]],<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>&mdash;released on [[November 7]], [[2001]]<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref>&mdash;before appearing in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="GB" /> released on [[November 11]], 2001.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> The camp appears in the first level of the Wookiee tutorial campaign, titled "Moving and Attacking," in which the player has to find the compound using Chewbacca and Shoran and then defend it from a gundark attack.<ref name="GB" />
